about_the_game:
This optional DLC adds a new Side Job for Karryn's Prison called the Gym Trainer!

Unlike all other encounters in the game, the Gym Trainer Side Job is the only place where Karryn is in absolute total control and the inmates are more so then ever at her imperial mercy! It's a unique reversal from all other experiences in Karryn's Prison!
If the following sounds interesting to you, then this DLC is for you!
  • The inmates just want to do their reps and get their gains and are minding their own business.
  • Karryn dictates the pace and the acts. Finally, Karryn is the one to initiate with the Talk, Sight, Pet and more!
  • The battle is purely one versus one, no one else is allowed to interfere.
  • The camera is set to a first person view as if you're looking up at Karryn while being totally helpless.

To get started, Level 3 needs to be Subjugated, and then you can buy a new Edict that unlocks the Gym Trainer job! The "objective" of being a Gym Trainer is to help inmates get a good workout session by first Observing their Form and then giving out Advice on what they can be doing better. Of course, being so close to a helpless, sweaty male might give certain Chief Wardens a different idea......

Note that to get the most of the new content in the Gym Trainer Side Job, an experienced, slutty Karryn is recommended. Because of how the game systems work, Karryn won't be able to initiate any sexual plays without certain Passives.

Alongside with the new Gym Trainer Side Job which comes with 5 new CGs and all their variations, it also comes with exclusive new voiced lines for the Gym Trainer Side Job! And also of course new Passives and Titles related to the new side job!

Furthermore, the Gym Trainer DLC also comes with a bonus of 200+ new voiced lines for battle skills like Revitalize, Healing Thoughts and Pleasure Stance!

content_descriptors.notes: Nudity; Sex at the gym; Sexual intercourse with multiple partners
